name: Seeed Studio XIAO nRF54L15
description: Nordic nRF54L15 (128 MHz Cortex-M33 + RISC-V coprocessor) XIAO with BLE 6.0 incl. channel sounding, Thread/Zigbee/Matter, NFC, USB-C and battery charging.
notes: 16 GPIO (D0-D15): D0-D10 on the side pads, D11-D15 on the back; the Sense version (separate SKU, $15.99) adds an IMU and PDM microphone and exposes 14 GPIO.
1.5 MB NVM (RRAM) / 256 KB RAM; supported by the Nordic nRF Connect SDK (Zephyr) and PlatformIO; check Arduino core status.
Standard 14-pad XIAO footprint (7 per side, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing); header coordinates assume the pads are centred on the 21 mm board length.
